title: A test batch finds a bug
notes: This machine is meant to accept the words that end in ab, but q1 goes back to q0 on a. The batch catches it: aab should be accepted and is not. The fix is q1 a -> q1 (after an a, another a still leaves us one b away), and the same batch then passes.
ops: start q0; accept q2; q0 a -> q1; q0 b -> q0; q1 a -> q0; q1 b -> q2; q2 a -> q1; q2 b -> q0
start q0; accept q2; q0 a -> q1; q0 b -> q0; q1 a -> q1; q1 b -> q2; q2 a -> q1; q2 b -> q0
